snippet.title: Frostpunk 2: The Surge | Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
⚡Wishlist #TheSurge: https://re.11bits.com/gc6
❄️Get #Frostpunk 2 Deluxe Edition with a 53% discount on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/60233/Frostpunk_2_Deluxe_Edition/

The journey is not over yet! Frostpunk 2: The Surge DLC will launch on PC and Consoles on December 14th!

Venture into a mysterious valley, uncover a new revolutionary resource, and harness nature's wrath in an all-new story scenario.
